title: CollectionInfo
description: One registry collection the query API can serve.

state.description: Lifecycle state (#353/#358): `active` (physical stores exist) | `archiving` (an archive version is being written; reads/writes proceed) | `dormant` (only the Workspace archive exists; the next authenticated read/ingest triggers a restore and answers 503 + Retry-After) | `restoring` (a restore is in flight; 503 + Retry-After) | `lost` (the archive is missing or failed verification; 409 until an explicit restore succeeds). Null/absent for a collection the registry does not track (the settings-derived default).

archive_pending.description: True when the last ingest/delete loaded but its archive step or upload failed: the collection stays active, cannot be evicted, and the owner's next authenticated call re-triggers the archive. Null/absent when untracked.

versions.description: Ordered archive version numbers recorded on the registry row (`versions/<n>/` in the owner's Workspace); a restore replays them in this order. Null/absent when untracked.

count.description: Tenant-scoped vector-store chunk count (own + public); null when unavailable.

text_count.description: Tenant-scoped text-index (BM25) chunk count; compare against `count` for a vector<->text parity check. Null when unavailable.

provenance.description: Build lineage from the collection's manifest; null when no manifest exists (e.g. COLLECTION_MANIFEST_DIR unset). `source` distinguishes a verified ingest record from lineage declared by the registry. Deliberately omits embedding_endpoints — internal infra URLs are not exposed on this principal-readable endpoint.

source.description: "ingest" (verified: written by a real ingest run) | "config" (declared: materialized from the registry spec).
